name: mcp-sqlserver
description: An MCP server for Microsoft SQL Server that enables executing read-only queries, listing tables, and describing database schemas. It offers specialized support for custom ports and multiple authentication methods including SQL credentials, NTLM, and Windows Integrated Auth.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server for Microsoft SQL Server that enables executing read-only queries, listing tables, and describing database schemas. It offers specialized support for custom ports and multiple authentication methods including SQL credentials, NTLM, and Windows Integrated Auth.

MSSQL_PORT.description: The SQL Server port. Defaults to 9123.

MSSQL_USER.description: The SQL login username. Required unless using Windows Integrated authentication.

MSSQL_CLIENT.description: Client key under 'clients' (e.g. a specific database name) used when loading configuration from a connections map file.

MSSQL_DOMAIN.description: The NTLM domain for domain\user authentication.

MSSQL_ENCRYPT.description: Whether to use encryption for the connection ('true' or 'false').

MSSQL_DATABASE.description: The database name to connect to. Defaults to 'master'.

MSSQL_PASSWORD.description: The SQL login password. Required unless using Windows Integrated authentication.

MSSQL_TRUST_CERT.description: Set to 'true' to trust self-signed or development certificates.

MSSQL_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to the JSON connections file. Defaults to 'connections.json' in the current working directory.

MSSQL_ENVIRONMENT.description: Environment key (e.g. staging, prod) used when loading configuration from a connections map file.

MSSQL_WINDOWS_INTEGRATED.description: Set to 'true' to use the current Windows OS user for authentication (requires msnodesqlv8).

MSSQL_TRUST_SERVER_CERTIFICATE.description: Alternative environment variable to 'MSSQL_TRUST_CERT'; set to 'true' to trust the server certificate.
